associations.rationale: The type constructs the type of cochain complexes, but does not itself state the square-zero differential law from the source claim.
The type introduces an exactness-at-a-degree predicate, but does not state that exactness is equivalent to vanishing cohomology.
The type introduces an exact-sequence predicate on a complex, but does not directly state its characterization by vanishing cohomology.
The type constructs a cohomology object at a degree, but does not state that this object is kernel modulo image.
The type extracts the differential between consecutive degrees, but does not itself assert that consecutive differentials compose to zero.
